name: Please Be a Human
source: Seven days in a freezing apartment. Nine friends and... two strangers. A nonlinear psychological thriller where every decision changes the ending. Sacrifice warmth, conscience, or loved ones to uncover the demons. There are no jump scares here—only the clinging fear that your loved one is already dead inside, and you continue to protect them.
